citations.text: The scanned 菜 entry reads: “形声字。从艸，采声。本义是指蔬菜。” It quotes Shuowen, “菜，艸之可食者”; cites 《尔雅·广物》“菜谓之蔬” and 《论语·乡党》“虽疏食菜羹，瓜祭，必齐如也”; and says the character also refers to dishes collectively, with 荤菜、川菜 and a 《北史·胡叟传》 example. The entry’s headword, cited characters, component clause, and prose were checked against the supplied scan pixels. It ends before the following 薄 entry. Page 62 was also inspected; it is a separate page and does not continue 菜.
